title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Joint Source and Parameter Estimation in Advection-Diffusion Equations
abstract: arXiv:2512.07755v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Source inversion problems under sparse measurements for parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) are particularly challenging to solve using physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), due to their severe ill-posedness and the multiple unknowns involved including the source function and the PDE parameters. Although the neural tangent kernel (NTK) of PINNs has been widely used in forward problems involving a single neural network, its extension to inverse problems involving multiple neural networks remains less explored. In this work, we propose a weighted adaptive approach based on the NTK of PINNs including multiple networks representing the solution, the unknown source, and the PDE parameters. The key idea behind our methodology is to simultaneously solve the joint recovery of these unknowns thereby using the underlying PDE as a constraint that couples multiple unknowns functional parameters, leading to more efficient us

translated_title: 用于对流扩散方程中源项与参数联合估计的物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 在稀疏测量条件下，抛物型偏微分方程（PDE）的源反演问题由于严重的病态性以及所涉及的多个未知量（包括源函数和PDE参数），使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解尤为困难。尽管PINNs的神经正切核（NTK）已广泛应用于仅涉及单个神经网络的正问题，但其在涉及多个神经网络的逆问题中的扩展仍较少被探索。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于PINNs神经正切核的加权自适应方法，其中包含表示解、未知源和PDE参数的多个神经网络。该方法的核心思想是同时求解这些未知量的联合恢复，将底层PDE作为耦合多个未知泛函参数的约束条件，从而实现更高效的参数利用。
tldr: 提出了一种基于多网络神经正切核的加权自适应PINN方法，以对流扩散方程为耦合约束，实现对源函数与PDE参数的联合估计，有效缓解稀疏测量下源反演的严重病态性问题。
